question: Does the rule-derived promotion-gain term in the default static evaluator improve finite-budget outcomes over Unit board/hand evaluation on fresh generated rules?
changed_premise: The isolated board-leaf and promotion-order contrasts do not test Evaluator._promotion_bonus. EvaluationConfig defaults promotion_potential_weight=3; the current profile derives promotion_gain_by_type from rule-based board-price gaps. Earlier leaf-only runs explicitly disabled this channel. This is a distinct live consumer and a decision-changing remaining price-derived interaction.

roots.selection: Retain all 16 deterministic legal-random roots; do not filter on promotion exposure, outcomes or action differences; no replacement.

arms.fixed_foe: Same Unit board/hand values, same rule-derived gain profile and other dynamic terms; promotion-potential weight zero in both arms.
arms.candidate_only_change: Unit board and hand values, capture ordering, type_value ordering, legal actions, dynamic mobility and anchor escape remain identical. Candidate differs only by enabling the existing rule-derived promotion bonus at the default weight 3; control weight is 0. Profile promotion_gain_by_type is derived once from the compiled rule price gaps and shared between candidate settings.
arms.search: Existing public Python AlphaBeta; default MoveOrderer, no TT; root tactical fallback disabled identically in both arms.

analysis.primary: Pair bonus-on minus bonus-off rewards at each exact root and owner; UNKNOWN contributes conservative [-1,+1] bounds before subtraction.
analysis.robustness: Report overall, owner, odd/even root parity and leave-one-seed-out bounds with each terminal/UNKNOWN retained.
analysis.cost: Compare candidate nodes, completed depth, fallback and elapsed caller costs separately; no standalone wall-time utility claim.
analysis.retain_rule: Keep the channel as a scoped evidence-supported candidate only if utility lower bounds are strictly positive overall, both owners, both parities and every leave-one-seed-out view, or median candidate-node reduction is at least10% overall and in both owner/parity strata while no corresponding utility lower bound is negative. Otherwise make no code/default change and close this sample.

integrity: Fresh generated rules only; full promotion/drop/auxiliary/history semantics and complete game-record replay retained.
Every action legal; preserve UNKNOWN, timeouts, failure and unstarted slots; no top-up, refit, solver or default change.
Assert board and hand leaf values, capture_order_value and type_value match between arms; promotion potential is the sole intended candidate change.
Poll PRIMARY stop flags before each game; frozen 3600-second cap.

cost.basis: Recent matched 64-game generated 5x5 D3 panel completed in246.656 seconds including full replay.

decision_after: This answers only whether this rule-derived bonus merits a scoped candidate; a positive result does not establish globally useful prices or authorize a default change.
